what_to_write: Include dollar amount of increase percentage amount and date increase takes effect For banked include years and amounts accumulated
deadline_or_timing: Serve ≥30 days before effective date if total increase in past 12 mo ≤10% 90 days if >10% +5 calendar days if mailed Use percentage in effect on effective date not serve date
consequence_if_missed: Increase ineffective or deemed unlawful; tenant may recover overcharge via petition.

what_to_write: Calculate on tenant base rent excluding temporary passthroughs/fluctuating charges Do not round up
consequence_if_missed: Overcharge recoverable; cannot round even $0.01 up.

what_to_write: Obtain current Rent Increase License via Housing Inventory reporting and fee payment before notice effective
deadline_or_timing: Before service and before increase effective date
consequence_if_missed: Unlicensed increase null and void per §37.15.

what_to_write: Only one increase per 12 months on anniversary
deadline_or_timing: 12 months after lease start or last increase

what_to_write: If you skip anniversary date increase becomes new anniversary; unaged bank lost
deadline_or_timing: Keep same anniversary month where possible; document if change
consequence_if_missed: Loss of 1.4% or prior bank permanently per SF.gov example.

what_to_write: Cannot charge extra because roommate added even if lease clause says so
For capital/O&M/bond passthrough include specific basis and Board certification/decision authorizing it
deadline_or_timing: Petition approved before notice 5 yr window for capital
consequence_if_missed: Secondary summary flagged; primary §37.7 — increase null if no petition.

what_to_write: Include Rent Board contact and hardship advisement for passthroughs
consequence_if_missed: Signals good faith expected in SF review; not strictly required for annual but strongly advised.

what_to_write: Retain copy of notice with date/method of service and mailing certificate if mailed
consequence_if_missed: Without proof cannot prove compliance in petition.

what_to_write: Do not impose within 180 days after tenant complaint organizing reporting violations
deadline_or_timing: Fair interval >180 days and neutral documentation
